title: fix(app-shell): the admin previews and the CEL lint advisories read the designer locale (objectui#10862, slice 2)
body:
Part of #10862
Clause-②: no — rows are added and a locale is passed; each en row equals today's literal. No declared surface or stored value moves.

Slice 2 of 3 (the admin previews and the CEL lint advisories), per triage `5860733428` and the slice-1 ACCEPT `5861649175`: one card, landed in slices by preview family. The card stays open for slice 3 (the object / data previews and the ten `fallbackHint` literals).

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 4 PM (claim `5861770181`, session `session_01MCg3z5cGrV51xEddpGcxEY`), implemented on `claude/issue-10862-designer-english-slice-2` as two commits on `main` `309d17b`. It uses the objectui#10832 / #10850 / #10857 / #10871 shape: `engine.*` rows whose en value is the literal each replaces, plus zh, read in the designer locale the surface already receives. No second catalogue.

## What changed

All under `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`.

- **The seven admin previews** (`previews/AppPreview.tsx`, `BookPreview.tsx`, `DatasourcePreview.tsx`, `EmailTemplatePreview.tsx`, `PermissionPreview.tsx`, `PositionPreview.tsx`, `TranslationPreview.tsx`) read 104 new `engine.*Preview.*` rows in the `locale` prop every production host already passes (`ResourceEditPage`, `EmbeddedItemEditor` and `StudioDesignSurface` hand it `useMetadataLocale()`). A sentence with a code span inside it (`navigation`, `groups`, `include`, `pages`, the `{{var}}` sample, a position's name) is one row with a `{token}` hole that the code span fills, through `withNodes` in a new `previews/row-nodes.ts` (the same function slice 1 wrote locally in `ActionPreview`), so the sentence keeps its own order in zh. `TranslationPreview`'s local `locale` (the bundle's own language, author data) is renamed `bundleLocale` so the prop can carry the designer's.
- **`celAuthoring.ts`** (the two advisories the slice-1 ACCEPT carried here). `lintCelPredicate` returns its two self-worded advisories as a catalogue key plus the values its holes take: the wrong-layer root's local sentence (`engine.celLint.notTheRow`, values `identifier` / `canonical`) and the non-pushdown-able `USING` filter (`engine.celLint.notPushdownable`, value `detail`, the engine's own reason). `CelLintIssue` is now a union: an error, a warning in its producer's words (`message`), or a warning in objectui's words (`messageKey` + `messageVars`). **No import is added to `celAuthoring.ts`**: it still imports nothing at load (the three dynamic `import()`s only), the slice-1 seam. The `@objectstack/lint` verdict branch keeps shipping that package's message as written.
- **`CelPredicateField.tsx`** renders every finding through `issueText`: the producer's message as written, or the keyed row read through the designer `t` its host already binds to the designer locale (`PermissionAdvancedFacets` via `PermissionMatrixEditor`, `ConditionBuilder`, `ObjectFieldInspector`, and `ViewVariantInspector` for `ConditionalFormattingEditor`), with the holes filled the way `tFormat` fills them. No new import there either.
- **`clientValidation.ts` is unchanged, by decision.** It is `lintCelPredicate`'s other caller, and it keeps errors only (`if (f.severity !== 'error') continue;`, then `f.message`). A keyed issue is typed as a warning only, so it never reaches that path, and the compiler proves it: after the error filter `f.message` is a `string`, and `tsc` passes. Nothing it surfaces changes.
- **`i18n.ts`**: 106 en rows (each equal to the replaced literal) and 106 zh rows, placeholders identical.
- One `.changeset/10862-designer-admin-previews-locale.md` (`patch` for `@object-ui/app-shell`).

## Census, confirmed per file (card site 4 for these seven, plus the two advisories)

Every census hit was read at source before it was counted. A site is one rendered designer word: an element's text, a `title`, an `aria-label` or a `placeholder`.

| file | rows | rendered sites | not counted, and why |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| `AppPreview` | 8 | 8 | `hint` (PreviewShell no longer renders it); nav kinds (spec enum tokens); routes and target names; the app's label and name |
| `BookPreview` | 22 | 22 | `hint`; the `(unnamed)` group-label fallback never renders (a group with neither key nor label is dropped first); `#N` order notation; doc names, badges, hrefs |
| `DatasourcePreview` | 10 | 11 | `SSL` (the protocol's name); `∅`, the redaction dots and `[N]` notation; `hint`; config keys and values (the key-count row serves the config table and the side blocks) |
| `EmailTemplatePreview` | 9 | 9 | the em-dash placeholder; `hint`; variable names and envelope values |
| `PermissionPreview` | 37 | 39 | the C / R / U / D / E / T / V* / M* column letters (the legend spells them out); the access-scope tokens (compacted enum values); the field-security tooltip (spec key notation); tab visibility values; `hint` (granted / not granted serve the cell `aria-label`s and the legend) |
| `PositionPreview` | 4 | 4 | `hint`; the position's label, name and description |
| `TranslationPreview` | 14 | 14 | `hint`; the coverage ratio notation; sample keys and values; the bundle's own locale |
| `celAuthoring.ts` | 2 | 2 | engine errors and warnings, and the `@objectstack/lint` field-rule message (producer text) |

Totals: 106 rows, 109 rendered sites, every one pinned.

## Tests

All at HEAD `5cac47f`.

- **Pins** (new): `previews/adminPreviews.i18n-10862-s2.test.tsx` (38 cases: each of the 19 mounts in zh and in en; 106 site assertions per language, plus the email template's `srcdoc` empty-body note) and `CelPredicateField.i18n-10862-s2.test.tsx` (6 cases: each advisory driven through the real field against the real engine in zh and en, plus a producer control per language where a covered slot ships `@objectstack/lint`'s message as written). Every zh expectation is read back from the catalogue and guarded against a missing row or an English one; every en case reads the en row through `t` / `tFormat` for `en-US`.
- **Red run A** (the seven preview sources checked out at base `309d17b`, blobs equal base; rows, helper and pins at HEAD; trap restore, blobs equal HEAD, `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes, porcelain 0 lines): `Tests 19 failed | 19 passed (38)`. The 19 failures are exactly the zh cases and list all 106 zh sites unrendered; all 19 en controls pass against the base sources, so each en row renders exactly what the literal rendered.
- **Red run B** (`celAuthoring.ts` and `CelPredicateField.tsx` at base, same restore proof): `Tests 4 failed | 4 passed (8)`. The four advisory cases fail (no keyed advisory at base) and both producer controls pass. A one-off test in the same run, deleted on the way out and never committed, confirmed that with `celAuthoring.ts` at base each advisory's literal equals `tFormat` of its en row, byte for byte.
- **Ablation** via `ablation-replace.mjs` wrap mode on `PermissionPreview.tsx`: the legend's locale thread cut (anchor 1 to 0, replacement 0 to 1, blob `ff4805f` to `964536c`) gives `Tests 1 failed | 37 passed (38)`, that one being the zh matrix case, listing exactly the four legend sites; the cells' `aria-label`s stay zh. Restored: blob equals HEAD `ff4805f`, `git diff HEAD` empty. The pins import the sources by relative path, so no `dist` sits between mutation and run.
- **Existing tests touched**, because the two advisory sentences left the code: `celAuthoring.test.ts` and `celAuthoring.fieldRuleVerdict-9318.test.ts` read a finding's English through the catalogue (`en(i)`), so every regex keeps checking the words an en author reads; `CelPredicateField.test.tsx` and `ConditionalFormattingEditor.test.tsx` mount with an identity `t` and now expect the key, as they already did for `perm.cel.valid`.
- **Related suites**, 240 files in four locked batches: the whole `previews/` tree, every test naming a changed component or a host of `CelPredicateField`, every `clientValidation` suite (the skew test included), the i18n pins and the gate-script suites. Results: `Test Files 60 passed (60) Tests 507 passed (507)`, `Test Files 56 passed (56) Tests 700 passed (700)`, `Test Files 57 passed (57) Tests 779 passed (779)`, `Test Files 67 passed (67) Tests 1580 passed (1580)`, each `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Static closure** (the slice-1 lesson). New static edges: the seven previews to `../i18n.js`, which each already reached through `./PreviewShell.js`, so no module set grows there; four previews to `./row-nodes.js`, a new module that imports only `react` and runs nothing at load; and the two `celAuthoring` test files to `./i18n`, both run above. `celAuthoring.ts` and `CelPredicateField.tsx` gain no import. Every test that mocks the designer `i18n` module inherits the original (`importOriginal`), so none loses `t` or `tFormat`.
- **Type check**: `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...` (28 of 28 tasks), then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (script echoed: `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists both new pin files and the four touched tests.
- Declared narrowing: the full `packages/app-shell` suite, repo-wide lint and `check:eager-closure` are CI's.

## Gates (at `5cac47f`, each exit 0)

`check:i18n-designer-parity` (Every en row has a zh row, and every shared row carries the same placeholders.) · `check:i18n-drift` (106 key(s) added, 0 en values changed) · `check:i18n-keys` · `check:designer-field-key-parity` · `check:control-bytes` · `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations) · `check:vi-mock-specifiers` / `check:vi-mock-inherit` / `check:vi-mock-override-shape` · `check:test-path-roots` · `check:unreferenced-sources` · `check:icon-record-names` · `check:esm-specifiers` · `check:self-import` · `check:phantom-deps` · `check:handler-key-reads` · `check:metadata-write-doors` · `check:action-forward-parity` · `check:element-data-source-declaration` · `check:changeset-claims` (report-only: three pending changesets name `i18n.ts`, 6310, 7125 and 8632; each paragraph read, still true) · `check:pending-changeset-literals` · `check-changeset-presence` · `check-changeset-no-major` · `check-changeset-fixed` · `check-changeset-overwrite` · `check-governed-queue-guard --test` (NOT GOVERNED, 18 paths) · `check:i18n-dead-keys` (report-only; none of the 106 new rows listed). ESLint on the 17 changed source and test files (`--format json`, 17 files): 0 errors with inline config honoured, as the package's own `eslint .` runs; every modified file carries the same error and warning counts as its base blob, with and without `--no-inline-config` (under the latter `AppPreview` shows the one inline-disabled `react-hooks/static-components` finding its base blob shows too), and the three new files carry none; `--print-config` resolves for all 17; the config enables no type-aware linting and no local rule reads the disk, so no untouched file can change verdict.

NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-closure` (needs a console build; the only new module on any static path is `row-nodes.ts`). A browser drive of the preview gallery, whose `I18nProvider` mounts in `en` (the dev-harness gap the card names as out of scope).

## Acceptance notes

- **File outside the claim's list**: `previews/row-nodes.ts`, the shared `withNodes` four of the previews read. Same defect class, no behaviour of its own, reachable (`check:unreferenced-sources` OK).
- `ActionPreview` still carries its own copy of `withNodes` from slice 1. Moving it onto the shared helper is a refactor, not a locale fix; whoever next edits `ActionPreview` can take it.
- **Same family, not in the census**: `external/ExternalDatasourcePanel.tsx`, rendered inside `DatasourcePreview` for a federated datasource, carries English of its own (the "Tables" / "Validation" tabs, "writes allowed" / "read-only", "Federation is not enabled on this server.", the save-first prompt). Read at source only. This card is the family's carrier, so it rides here for a later slice.
- The preview gallery still mounts `I18nProvider` in `en` (out of scope, as the card says).
- Remaining for slice 3: the object / data previews and the ten `fallbackHint` literals.
